docs.summary: Writes one container format. Hand an implementation to [`Register`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ImageEncoderRegistry~Register) to add a format or replace a built in encoder. Implementations must not throw for a layout they cannot write; they report [`UnsupportedFeature`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ApertureError~UnsupportedFeature) and leave the stream as they found it.
Extension to give a file of this format, leading dot included, lowercase.
The layouts this encoder writes without converting first. A frame in any other layout is converted to [`PreferredPixelFormat`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.IImageEncoder~PreferredPixelFormat) on the way in.
What an unsupported layout is converted to before writing.

members.name: TryEncode
members.signature: bool TryEncode(ImageFrame frame, EncodeOptions options, Stream destination, out ApertureError error)

docs.summary: Writes `frame` to `destination`. Nothing is written when this returns false.
